svg.text: Download and stage the fixed runtime
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
APP01 · browser, File Explorer and PowerShell
Open https://www.php.net/downloads.php → Windows downloads → PHP 8.4 → x64 Non Thread Safe →
Zip. The October 21 fixes begin at 8.4.27. Use a newer patched 8.4 release if one is available
and compatible; do not switch major/minor branches merely to get a larger number.
Compare Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 on the actual downloaded ZIP with its official published
SHA-256 before extracting. A matching filename alone does not validate a download.
Extract into a NEW folder, for example C:\PHP-8.4.27. If your downloaded version is newer, use
that version in the folder name and in every following path. Keep the previous runtime intact.
Start from the new package’s php.ini-production. Reapply the recorded settings deliberately.
Point extension_dir to this new folder’s ext directory and keep session/upload/log paths on the
existing protected runtime folders. Use only matching x64 NTS extensions built for this PHP
branch; do not copy old DLLs wholesale.
Run the candidate checks below. Read any missing-runtime or extension warnings before
Check: A separate candidate folder contains a verified supported patched runtime, matching
